title: Isopiestic Measurements on the System H2O-NaCl-Na2SO4 at 25 C
experimental_method: Isopiestic method: solutions in seven silver cups in a gold plated copper block inside an evacuated desiccator rotated 4-7 days in a 25 C water bath; concentrations by weighing dry salts and water.
uncertainties_stated: Bath 25 +- 0.005 C; Na2SO4.10H2O solubility 1.9503 +- 0.0020 m (mean of seven runs); uncertainty in log gamma usually about 0.005.
quality_remarks: Set 13 combines four runs with saturated Na2SO4 reference (two with dried A.R. chemicals, large scatter); set 21 had a solid phase present (probably Na2SO4.7H2O) and is flagged unreliable by the author; Na2SO4 solutions beyond 1.95 m are supersaturated. Table I gives end-member molality pairs and fit coefficients only; the mixed-solution molalities are not printed. PDF page 1 begins with the end of another article (reference list of a Sage/Sengers paper), ignored.

not_extracted_tables.Table II: mean activity coefficients (and m_B + m_C compositions) derived by the author from isopiestic data; e.m.f. columns are literature (Gieskes, Lanier)
